headline: Space Bunny hits 24.5%, OpenAI's new Luna Pro breaks records
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha just posted an all-time high of 24.5% token share, up 2.4 points overnight and 9.8 points over the week. OpenAI's fresh gpt-6-luna-pro-20260922 debuted at rank 18 with a record 0.9% share after jumping 16 spots in a single day. DeepSeek holds steady at 21.6% despite a slight dip, while the top two providers now command 46.1% of the market combined.
highlights: openai/gpt-6-luna-pro-20260922: new entrant at rank 18, 0.9% share (all-time high for this model)
